subject.title: [Feature]: WebUI notification system, cron job management popups, and context monitor integration

question: Should OpenClaw add a core connected-Control-UI in-app notification/action queue for cron results and context pressure, and which related action surfaces should share that contract?
rationale: Current main has partial cron, Web Push, and context-monitoring surfaces, but the remaining request changes Control UI product architecture and overlaps open notification/action issues rather than being a narrow repair.

options.title: Scope core notification queue first
options.body: Define one connected-Control-UI notification/action contract, then wire cron-finished and context-pressure events into it through focused follow-up work.

options.title: Fold into related action issues
options.body: Make a related tracker such as connected-UI notifications or inline actions canonical, and keep this issue as UX requirements for that broader contract.

options.title: Defer in-app toasts
options.body: Keep the current inline cron, Web Push, and context-ring surfaces unless maintainers explicitly sponsor a core toast/snooze layer.

recommendation.title: Scope core notification queue first
recommendation.body: Define one connected-Control-UI notification/action contract, then wire cron-finished and context-pressure events into it through focused follow-up work.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has prior review context on this issue and recent cron notification routing history, making him the best available product-scope owner from the evidence.
